content.text: So Marco, when you lose your cool, is it always that you get angry?
content.trans: 所以马科，当你失去冷静时，总是会变得生气吗？

content.text: You don't always get angry.
content.trans: 您不会总是生气。

content.text: So we can listen to our dialogue now for the third time and then we'll come back and talk
content.trans: 所以现在我们可以再次倾听我们的对话，然后我们再回来继续讨论。

content.text: about this bank robbery business.

content.text: All right, so this is what we're going to do.
content.trans: 好的，那么我们打算怎么做呢。

content.text: I've carefully mapped this out so don't screw it up.
content.trans: 我仔细地规划好了这个，不要出问题。

content.text: Mr. Rabbit, you and Mr. Fox will go into the bank wearing these uniforms.
content.trans: 先生、兔子和狐狸将穿上这些制服去银行。

content.text: We've managed to get replicas of the one the guards wear for when they pick up the money.
content.trans: 我们已经成功地复制了那些士兵在取钱时佩戴的备用装备。

content.text: Got it.
content.trans: 明白了。

content.text: No problem boss.
content.trans: 没问题老板。

content.text: When you get inside, tell them that you're filling in for Carl and Tom and say that they're on another route today.
content.trans: 当你进入时，告诉他们你正在替卡尔和汤姆填表，并说今天他们将换一条路。

content.text: Don't lose your cool.
content.trans: 不要失去冷静。

content.text: Just act natural.

content.text: What did they want to call and confirm?

content.text: Are you ready?

content.text: Let's go.

content.text: So there's a lot of movies about bank robberies, but obviously they happen in real life.
content.trans: 所以有很多关于银行抢劫的电影，但很明显它们发生在现实中。

content.text: So this dialogue is actually based on real events, right?
content.trans: 所以，这个对话实际上基于实际事件吗？

content.text: Yeah, this actually happened in real life and so it's actually a very creative and non-violent way of robbing a bank.
content.trans: 是的，这在现实中确实发生过，并且这是一种非常有创意和非暴力的方式抢劫银行。

content.text: Okay, so what happened?
content.trans: 好的，那么发生了什么？

content.text: Basically, this guy went to a bank dressed up as one of those security guards that transport the money from the bank to another safe place.
content.trans: 基本来说，这个家伙穿上了那个负责从银行将钱送到另一个安全地方的保安。

content.text: He had fake credentials or replica credentials and...
content.trans: 他有假的认证或复制品认证...

content.text: So fake ID.
content.trans: 所以假身份证。

content.text: Yeah, he had a replica of the uniform.
content.trans: 是的，他有一套仿制的军装。

content.text: Wow.
content.trans: 哇。

content.text: And he walked in, he took all these bags, him and his partner, and they took him to the truck and drove off.
content.trans: 他走着，他拿走了这些包，他和他的伴侣一起去了卡车，然后开车走了。

content.text: And the bank didn't realize that they had been robbed.
content.trans: 和银行没有意识到他们被抢劫。

content.text: They thought it was a routine thing.
content.trans: 他们认为这是例行事情。

content.text: Three or four hours later, the real security guard shows up.
content.trans: 三四个小时后，真正的安全员出现了。

content.text: They were long gone and they still can't find them.
content.trans: 他们已经远去了，但他们仍然找不到它们。

content.text: Really? So a very clever plan.
content.trans: 真的吗？所以一个非常聪明的计划。

content.text: Very clever and very effective, I think.
content.trans: 非常聪明而且非常有效，我认为。

content.text: They stole over half a million dollars.
content.trans: 他们盗走了超过半百万美元。

content.text: Okay, well guys, don't try this at home.
content.trans: 好的，各位，请不要在家里尝试这个。

content.text: Don't try this at home, but real life, real English, right?
content.trans: 不要在家里尝试，而是要真实的生活、真实的英语。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: Okay, so come to our website, leave your questions and comments, tell us what you think will happen with these guys.
content.trans: 好的，那么请到我们的网站，留下您的问题和评论，告诉我您对这些家伙的看法。

content.text: Yeah, they might end up in jail.
content.trans: 是的，他们可能会被关押。

content.text: Who knows?

content.text: Maybe somebody will lose their cool and get caught, right?
content.trans: 是的，也许有人会失去理智并被抓住。

content.text: Well, thanks for listening guys and until next time.
content.trans: 好的，谢谢大家听我讲话了。下一次见！
